name: devcity
description: DevCity — The developer's living city. Your code builds the world.

scripts.agents:report: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='.antigravity/reports';try{const f=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json')).sort().reverse()[0];f?console.log(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,f),'utf-8')):console.log('No reports yet')}catch{console.log('No reports folder yet')}"
scripts.agents:health: node -e "try{const s=require('./.antigravity/memory/ecosystem-state.json');const h=s.codebase_health_history||[];console.log(h.length?'Score: '+h[h.length-1].score+'/100':'No data yet')}catch(e){console.log('No health data yet')}"
